topography.project_purpose: Prediction Market. Structurally: 48 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 29 common project-authored base contract(s) (eip712, multicall, erc721permit). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
